text_block_list.text: Half of my life...
is made up of "thank yous."

Um... please!
Would you... become my trainer...?!
choice_data_list: Huh... wha?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This was just a few days after arriving at Tracen Academy as a rookie trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere, the horsegirl I had just been watching on the track
made this desperate plea to me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hadn't stopped by the track specifically looking to scout anyone.
After all, I was a complete novice. I was merely getting a feel for the campus facilities.
choice_data_list: (And yet... I couldn't tear my eyes away.)

text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah, hah...
HAAAH—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHOOSH—!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Calling her "fast"... felt nowhere near sufficient.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turf scattered. The wind roared.
Like a single streak of lightning, like a shooting star tearing through the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was almost like—a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Swiftly, swiftly, purely swift, she sprinted across the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was why it slipped out before I could think.
A tremor of awe, deeper than anything I'd ever felt, spilled from my lips.
choice_data_list: Incredible... What blazing speed...!
Incredible... What amazing speed...!

text_block_list.text:
! ......
...Um, excuse me... Were you talking to me?
choice_data_list: Ah, sorry to blurt that out! Your running was just so amazing...

text_block_list.text: No, please! It makes me... so very happy to hear that!

Um... please!
Would you... become my trainer...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And that leads us back to where this all began...

Ah... um, I'm sorry for springing this on you out of the blue.
It's just, I... I desperately want to make my debut...!
choice_data_list: L-Let's just take a breath and talk this over first!

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I took up your time so suddenly...
Thank you for listening to me.
choice_data_list: No, it's fine. Don't worry about it.
Not at all. Don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Finding a trainer to scout them is vital for any horsegirl. It's only natural she'd be desperate.
All the more reason why we needed to discuss this calmly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The girl, who introduced herself as K.S. Miracle, had pleaded passionately,
saying she desperately wanted to debut, but—
choice_data_list: What is your reason for running...?
What's the reason you want to run...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to repay the kindness I've received.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To make it this far... so many people supported me,
so many people saved my life.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All the wonderful things they gave me... dreams, hopes, miracles.
I want to run and win, so I can give all of that back to them.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: No matter what happens, I must.
choice_data_list: I see... Repaying your debt of gratitude...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Twinkle Series is arduous enough on its own.
Many girls only reach this point through immense support from those around them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her gratitude toward those people feels exceptionally deep and resolute.
With her clear, earnest eyes... she is a sincere girl who inspires genuine support.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her talent is undeniable, as I witnessed firsthand.
In that case—!
choice_data_list: ...To be honest, I'm just a complete rookie who only recently arrived.
...To be honest, I'm just a total rookie who just got here.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ! ...Is that so?
choice_data_list: Yeah. But if you're okay with that...!
Yes. But if you're willing to accept that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she was willing to give it her all alongside me,
I told her... I would gladly sign a contract with her.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...! Ah... yes, yes, absolutely!!
Thank you, Trainer...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that agreed, I didn't have the paperwork on hand...
so we arranged for her to visit the trainers' office tomorrow.
choice_data_list: (Alright! Time to give it my all...!)
(Alright! I have to do my best...!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Fufufu, you certainly look full of energy today♪
It's wonderful to see you so motivated!

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Did something good happen?
Don't tell me... you already managed to sign a trainee?!
choice_data_list: Actually, that's exactly what happened...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still buzzing with excitement, I shared that I was set to officially sign
an incredible horsegirl tomorrow named K.S. Miracle, who possessed both exceptional talent and willpower.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right after I said that, however—

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle... You don't mean that frail-looking girl, do you?
...Are you really sure about this?
choice_data_list: Huh? What do you mean, 'sure about this'...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My colleague's expression turns grave. Even Tazuna-san wears a concerned look.
I can tell immediately that something isn't right.
choice_data_list: Tazuna-san... Do you know something about this?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Understood, I'll tell you. But would you mind if we
moved somewhere else? Somewhere with fewer people around...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You were asking about K.S. Miracle, correct?
...Well, to start with—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
She's one of the rare students who transferred into the Senior Division.
And the reason she didn't enroll in the Junior Division—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Was because she couldn't. ...Her body was far too frail.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I heard she spent practically her entire childhood in hospitals.
...Frankly speaking, the fact that she can run like that today is a miracle in itself.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: —And yet, she's "too fast."

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You hear about it sometimes, right? Umamusume whose bodies
can't keep up with the speed they produce... When the engine is so powerful the chassis simply can't hold up.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It's even worse for someone who was sickly from the start.
...And on top of that, her spirit is "too strong."

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I saw her run in a mock race once...
To be blunt, it terrified me. ...Her running style is downright dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Her drive to run is just too intense.
Even if the strain pushes her into the danger zone... she never eases off the throttle.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
It's not that she "can't stop"—it's that she "won't stop."
Do you really understand how terrifying that is?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle herself... is a wonderful Umamusume.
Even without a contract, she continues to work tirelessly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To gain an opportunity to prove herself, she even entered the Track Meets...
the intramural event where students can choose their preferred courses and distances.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: She truly has an incredible amount of drive. However...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If you plan on taking her on, you need serious resolve and technical skill.
Leave her to her own devices, and she'll likely break past her limits... in the worst way possible.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You have to be able to assess that and put on the brakes, no matter what.
...Can you honestly say with absolute confidence that you can do that?
choice_data_list: ...Well...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was at a loss for words. ...Yet that silence spoke for itself.
A rookie without knowledge or proven skill had no right to nod...
